description.title: פרטי חשבון בנק
description.summary: This table is a form for collecting bank account details to facilitate claim payments. It's used to verify account information and ensure accurate fund transfers to Harel Insurance customers.
description.embed_passage: טופס זה משמש לקבלת פרטי חשבון בנק לצורך העברת תשלומים בעקבות תביעה שאושרה. הלקוח מאשר לחברת הראל לקבל מידע מהבנק על דיוק הפרטים, כולל מספר זהות, דרך מרכז הסליקה הבנקאי. אישור זה נדרש כדי למנוע טעויות בהעברת הכספים.

טבלה: פרטי חשבון בנק
This table is a form for collecting bank account details to facilitate claim payments. It's used to verify account information and ensure accurate fund transfers to Harel Insurance customers.
ממדים: Individual claimant/insured, Bank account details and authorization

BANK ACCOUNT DETAILS FORM
If your claim is approved, please provide details of an account in Israel for a bank transfer. Please attach a photocopy of a canceled check or confrmation regarding management of the insured's bank. In the event that you do not approve inspection of the bank account details.
Bank
Branch name
Branch No.
Account No.
Payment in regard to a claim by a minor: we the undersigned, the minor's parents request that the insurance benefts in respect of claim number                                                     be transferred to the joint bank account in our name                                                     or alternatively to the mother's or father's account No.                                                       in the name of                                                      . A photocopy of a check or bank account confrmation must be attached, in the event that you do not approve inspection of the bank
account details.
In the alternative, provide a copy of a check in the name of the mother or father. Please attach a photocopy of both parents' ID cards. By signing this document, we hereby confrm that upon receipt of the insurance benefts as requested above, we and/or whomsoever on our behalf shall  not  have  any  claim  and/or  allegation  of  any  type  whatsoever  against  Harel  Insurance  Company  Ltd.  and/or whomsoever on its behalf in regard to execution of payment in respect of this claim.
Parent's Name
I.D. No.
Signature
Parent's Name
I.D. No.
Signature
In order to transfer funds to your account, we request you to confrm by signing hereunder, that you authorize Harel Insurance Investments and Financial Services Ltd. and the companies under its control to receive information from the bank regarding the accuracy of the details of the account which is conducted in your name, as well as the ID number in this account by means of a Bank Clearing Center, in order to verify your statement regarding the bank account owned by you. In addition, you waive bank confdentiality and any allegation against the bank, and instruct the bank to provide the requested information for this purpose. The information is required to identify the correct bank account details before any payments are made, and in order to avoid errors when transferring benefts.
*Until the date on which the Bank Clearing Center is contacted, you may withdraw this consent by contacting our company customer service hotline at * 2735.
